the trickster — circle or sphere as costume

head — reaches
tail — reached
the mouth — the operative opening
assimilation — what enters changes the life that receives
Saturn — blocked gut: reception becomes detention
the Eden-serpent — the hole traded for the fork
C24 fusion — a mouth that takes every answer as confirmation
the torus — formed surface around an opening it cannot convert into surface
the opening — Anuttara/Paramaśiva owns it; Māyā is the measure wound around it
γ(t)=[2t,−t] — returns to its start; lift ends at (2,−1)
χ(T²)=0 · π₁(T²)≅ℤ×ℤ — the topological neighbour
earthlight — the excluded ground's return as event
tokamak — the doughnut chamber; magnetic confinement
plasma held so activity can continue
Q27 energetics — release and holding do different work
mother and child — nourishment through differentiated dependency
Prajāpati's self-offering; horse/universe (p.29 lead)
En-Soph; the self-rolling wheel (p.18)
world parents — day at #5, night at #0, four directions at #1–#4 (p.108)
Jung's Self/shadow horizon; Gebser's changed seeing
the round — wholeness keeping its opening
the intact hole — constitutive, not absent
